action_summary: Replace logit averaging with equal-weight arithmetic averaging of the individually normalized probability distributions across all four TTA views and all five existing folds. Preserve the binary sigmoid convention using the mathematically equivalent, numerically stable softmax(logsigmoid(logits)) in float32. This targets excessive confidence caused by averaging logits and has a credible KL-loss benefit when ensemble members disagree, but improvement is unmeasured without data. Preserve checkpoints, architecture, preprocessing, augmentation views, Kaggle paths and submission columns; add a tiny numerical floor, probability validity assertions and an explicit submission DataFrame copy. No training or inference was run.
